name: header
description: The website's pinned header on mobile and tablet (the quiet navbar): the masthead above the destinations, pinned over the page's reader. Reading away from the journal's end, it compacts: the masthead clears, the destinations rise to the top and the date settles into their slot; back at the end it expands again. Desktop keeps the masthead and its sticky column, never this header.

form.description: static: the masthead and the destinations pinned as one unit, as the numbered comps draw them (no script, nothing added). navbar: the quiet navbar's end state, with the compact wordmark and date parts, the destinations' date slot and the masthead's aria-hidden placeholders; header.js drives it.

noRule.navbar: no rule of its own: its rules read the parts (aj-s-header__brand, aj-s-header__date) the navbar form renders and the data-state header.js sets, not the attribute

children.description: The masthead (role head) and the destinations with their date slot (role nav, dest slot: true).

places.head: the masthead: the full head while expanded; cleared (opacity 0, inert) while compact
places.nav: the destinations: under the masthead while expanded, at the top while compact; the header sets their link sizing through the dest's exposed properties

states.default: yes: expanded at the reading end (data-state="expanded")
states.hover: n/a: a section is not a control; its links carry their own
states.focus-visible: n/a: not focusable; its links carry the ring
states.selected: yes: compact (data-state="compact") while the reader is away from its end
states.loading: n/a: written with the page; its geometry is measured once fonts are ready
states.empty: n/a: rendered only on pages with the five destinations

behaviour.script: header.js, inside its root only: measures its masthead, destinations, wordmark and date; lays out and tweens the compact wordmark and date (transforms, its own height, the masthead's opacity and inert); writes data-state, data-type (large when the destinations' type is enlarged on a narrow page) and data-tween (off while it must not animate, and under reduced motion unless the review switch is on); dispatches header:resize with its height. It follows data-reading, which the app sets.

data-reading.description: The reader's intent as the app reads it from scroll, wheel, touch and keys: home (at the journal's end, or a page's top) or away.

data-state.description: What the header shows: the full masthead (expanded) or the destinations alone at the top (compact).

data-type.description: The destinations' type is enlarged on a page narrower than 600: they wrap onto three lines (Today and Reflections; Timeline and Ask; the date's row before You).

data-date.description: The compact date's form (v4 B7), set only while compact: full where the whole date fits at its compact size (18px: tablets); short, its core (9 Aug) alone with the weekday and year faded, if that reaches the destinations' size (at most 12px); none, faded out, if neither does (a phone under about 355px).

data-tween.description: No transition this frame (a layout pass, or reduced motion without the review switch).

resize.detail: { height }: the header's height in px
resize.description: After every layout: the app sets the composer's --journal-header-height from it.

a11y.role: header (banner of the page's reader); the compact wordmark and date are aria-hidden copies, the masthead stays the named source
a11y.keyboard: none of its own: its links; the masthead is inert while compact
a11y.labels: the masthead's wordmark and the destinations' labels

responsive.600: below 600 the destinations may take large type (data-type)
responsive.desktop: not rendered: desktop keeps the masthead's sticky column

changelog.change: New section (behaviour round 3): the website's pinned header, which journal-navbar.js used to build at runtime.

v4 B7: five destinations (Reflections next to Today). The navbar form needs five; enlarged type wraps to three rows; phones under 414 take the 360px tightening; the compact date is written in parts and drawn full, short (9 Aug) or not at all (data-date).
seg from uses and the Timeline fixture: Timeline's List/Calendar zoom is gone (v4 C1); its masthead carries the date box.
The compact date follows the date box: when the app writes another date into the masthead (Ask opening a past day), header.js rewrites its parts and measures again.

The masthead markers the navbar hides (the wordmark and the date box it redraws) leave icons out: a back control in the masthead (Timeline's way back to a reflection, v4 C3) keeps its chevron, and the script no longer takes the chevron for the date.
v4 round 10 fixes 5: the quiet navbar hides only its held placeholders (data-held), not everything aria-hidden in the masthead; You's loading date, a bone, was hidden.
